title: Israel votes, an Iran strike on hold, Intel's quantum deal
summary: Israel votes today after reports that Netanyahu pushed Trump for a pre-election strike on Iran and was told to wait; Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani officials hold first-ever joint talks in Tehran; Intel buys Israeli quantum startup Classiq for two point three billion dollars.

title: Lula's comeback, a clash over Iran, Israel votes tomorrow
summary: Lula wins a fourth term in Brazil as Flávio Bolsonaro refuses to concede; Israel's army chief reportedly resists a Netanyahu order on Iran a day before the election; Serbia's Vučić concedes defeat to a student-led movement.

title: Trump's "maybe tomorrow", a huge rally, Brazil decides
summary: Trump says a strike on Iran could come "maybe tomorrow" as an Iranian lawmaker raises nuclear weapons; tens of thousands rally in Tel Aviv for an October seventh inquiry two days before Israel votes; Brazil chooses between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro today with the final polls at fifty-one to forty-nine.

title: Hebron attack, a strike "absolutely" possible, Brazil votes
summary: Two Israeli soldiers are killed in a Hebron checkpoint attack and the city is sealed three days before Israel votes; a US envoy says a strike on Iran could "absolutely" come this weekend as Brent tops 117 dollars; Brazil picks between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in a dead-heat runoff tomorrow.

title: Final polls, Hormuz flare-up, Art Basel shuts early
summary: The last Israeli polls before the ban show a dead heat four days before the vote; Iran's Revolutionary Guard claims hits on seven ships as Brent tops 112 dollars; Art Basel Paris closes two days early as France braces for more protests.

title: Iran strike plans, Eisenkot's red line, Lander detained
summary: The US and Israel reportedly plan new strikes on Iran after the US midterms as Netanyahu orders the regime's overthrow; Eisenkot rules out serving under Netanyahu five days before the vote; New York's Brad Lander is detained by Israeli troops at a West Bank olive harvest.

title: Eisenkot widens lead, Iran says no, Sixers spoil ring night
summary: New polls show Eisenkot's Yashar ahead with neither bloc near 61 seats six days before Israel's election; Iran tells mediators its enriched uranium will never leave the country as oil tops 111 dollars; the 76ers beat the Knicks on championship banner night.

title: Gantz bows out, Egypt waits, Shashua's $200M AI bet
summary: Benny Gantz pulls out of Israel's election a week before the vote; Egypt's parliament delays its vote on defending Saudi Arabia as Russia's Lavrov lands in Tehran; Amnon Shashua's new startup doubleAI launches with two hundred million dollars.

title: Trump endorses Bibi, Egypt eyes war, Wiz buys McDonald's?
summary: Trump gives Netanyahu his "complete and total endorsement" eight days before Israel's election; Egypt moves toward defending Saudi Arabia against the Houthis; Wiz's billionaire founders close in on buying McDonald's Israel.

title: Hormuz on fire, diplomats attacked, Varonis sells for $6.3B
summary: Iran claims tankers hit mines in Hormuz as oil nears $110; settlers attack European diplomats in the West Bank and Rubio steps in; Israeli data-security pioneer Varonis is sold to Proofpoint for six point three billion dollars.

title: Escalation warnings, a Shin Bet lawsuit, a $42M Kandinsky
summary: Israel's army chief warns of escalation before the election; ex-Shin Bet chief Ronen Bar sues Netanyahu over October 7 blame; Christie's London makes $289 million, led by a restituted Kandinsky.

title: Iran before the vote, Aramco hit, and the Pope's diagnosis
summary: Netanyahu reportedly pressed Trump to resume the Iran war before Israel's election; the Houthis hit an Aramco building as the Saudi-Houthi war escalates; Pope Leo is diagnosed with lung cancer after surgery.

title: Airlines quit Riyadh, a hike turns deadly, Orion's $500M
summary: Qatar Airways and Etihad suspend flights to Saudi cities as Houthi strikes continue; a teenager is killed by an old Hezbollah bomblet on a school hike in the north; CrowdStrike is in advanced talks to buy Israeli startup Orion for about five hundred million dollars.

title: Riyadh hit again, Bennett's phone line and a $7B Decart deal
summary: Riyadh's airport is hit a fourth time as the FAA tells US airlines to use caution; Bennett tells Netanyahu he's "welcome to give me a call"; Amazon is in talks to buy Israeli-founded AI startup Decart for about seven billion dollars.

title: An American killed in Riyadh, and a race to the threshold
summary: The Riyadh airport death toll climbs to twelve including an American as Trump weighs strikes; Gantz and Winter refuse to quit Israel's election race; Florence Pugh's East of Eden tops Netflix.

title: A Nobel snub, a Saint Laurent exit and a Gaza anniversary
summary: Navi Pillay wins the Nobel Peace Prize and the US sanctions the ICC hours later; the UAE confirms the flydubai copilot planned a 9/11-style attack; Gaza's ceasefire turns one year old today.

title: Tampered records, a renamed consulate and a T. rex cousin
summary: Netanyahu's former military secretary alleges October 7 records were altered; Britain's Jerusalem consulate is downgraded and twenty diplomats leave; Trump says no strike on Iran before the US midterms.

title: A tied race, a flydubai fallout and a Koons sale
summary: A new poll shows Israel's election deadlocked; the flydubai scare puts Israelis' US visa waiver at risk; Mamdani's October 7 statement sparks a firestorm in New York.

title: Three years since October 7, and a race to the ballot box
summary: Israel marks three years since October 7; Arab parties cleared for the October 27 election; a 450 million dollar Van Gogh and Cézanne sale heads to New York.
